segments.text: Someone has a terrible month. You sit them down and get tough. Next month, they bounce back. Proof tough love works, right?
Then someone has a great month. You praise them. Next month, they slip. So praise makes people worse?
No. Neither one did anything. Extreme results drift back toward average on their own. It's called regression to the mean.
You just took credit for something that was going to happen anyway. Be careful what lesson you learn from it.
Your brain is built to miss this one. Full verdict on the channel.
